text: End of course test, track 2. Hi Haru, I hear you have a new job. Yes, I'm going to work as a ranger. What's that? It's a person who helps care for nature. So you help animals? Not really. Although I have to make sure the places they live in are safe. It's my dream job and that's why I went to university. There is one problem though. What's that? Well, it's in the countryside so I have to leave my hometown. I'm not sure I want to do that. Where is the job? In Turwik. It's more than 100 km away so I have to move and live on my own. Do you have to find somewhere to live? No. One of the good things about this job is that it has a cabin. What's that? Is it like a stone house? No. It's a small wooden house that I can live in while I work for the company. When I leave, I have to find another place to live. Is the money good? It's okay, but not great. I will earn enough to buy all my food, but I don't think I can afford to go out very much or come home often. I think I'll be very busy so I won't have much free time. Do you think you'll be lonely? You won't have any friends there. I know, but I enjoy being alone too. Well, we can all come and visit you in the holidays. That would be great!
